reason: PURE. First thing I noticed was the sachets: pocket-sized, one a day, tear open with one hand, so no counting capsules into my pill case before a flight. The 200 mg is two capsules, but the listing says so up front, and bisglycinate is the form I want for sleep. I'd try one box.
objection: Brand has zero reviews, so I'm taking the lab-test claim on faith until I scan the QR and see a real batch report. At $1 a day it's also pricier than the bottle of capsules I could just count out myself.
would_change_my_mind: A few real verified reviews, or a QR report that opens to a named lab and a batch that matches the box.
